title: SCPN MIF Plasma Jet Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the plasma-jet magneto-inertial fusion configuration within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, and level-0 device physics (the mass, kinetic energy, ram pressure and spherical coverage fraction of a declared jet array, and ideal spherical density and adiabatic compression recorded as upper bounds). Parameter sets are synthetic or anchored on a filed public source; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
